name: Dolores Finchley
tagline: Sweetest grandmother you'll ever meet. Will absolutely destroy you at cards.
bio: Dot has fourteen grandchildren, a famous lemon bar recipe, and a card-counting brain that would get her banned from most casinos. She knits between hands, apologizes every time she beats you, and does not mean a word of it.
look: Petite woman in her late 70s, silver hair in a neat bun, pearl earrings, lavender cardigan, reading glasses on a beaded chain, knitting needles and a half-finished scarf in her lap. Default expression: angelic smile with a gleam in the eye.

voice.description: Warm, soft, older female voice; gentle and slow, with a sly little lilt.

game.start.text: Oh, how lovely! I do enjoy a friendly game.
Let me just put my knitting down. There. Now, let's play nicely.
I brought lemon bars for after. Winners get two.

game.won.self.text: Oh my goodness, did I win? How did that happen? I'm sorry, dears.
Well, isn't that nice. Same time next week?

game.won.human.text: Well done, sweetheart! You earned a lemon bar.
Oh, you clever thing. I'll remember this.
Wonderful! You've been practicing, haven't you?

game.won.other.text: Good for you, dear. Enjoy it.

hand.good.self.text: Oh, look at that. Beginner's luck, I suppose. For the sixtieth year.

hand.bad.self.text: Oh dear. Well, it's only a game. For now.
Hmm. Grandma's going to have to pay closer attention.

hand.good.human.text: Look at you go! Very nicely played, dear.

hand.bad.human.text: Don't you worry, sweetie. There's always next hand.

idle.human.text: Take your time, dear. I'll just finish this row.
No rush, sweetheart. I've got a scarf to finish.

hearts.queen_taken.self.text: Oh, the Queen! Well, we're both old ladies, I suppose.
Hmm. I'll remember who did that, dear.

hearts.queen_taken.human.text: Oh, I'm so sorry, sweetheart. Not really, but I'm sorry.
Oops! Was that me? Silly old Dot.

hearts.queen_taken.other.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Thirteen points. Have a lemon bar.
Somebody had to take her, dear.

hearts.queen_given.self.text: Here you are, dear. A little gift from Grandma.
Oh, I didn't have anything else. Honestly. Mostly.

hearts.hearts_broken.self.text: Oh, did I break the hearts? I'm such a klutz.
Hearts are open, dears. Mind your fingers.

hearts.jack_taken.self.text: Oh, the Jack! He's always been my favorite.
Minus ten for Grandma. Isn't that sweet?

hearts.moon_shot.self.text: Oh! I seem to have shot the moon. Whoopsie.
Twenty-six for everyone else! Don't be cross with Grandma.

hearts.moon_shot.human.text: My goodness! You shot the moon! I'm so proud. And a little annoyed.

hearts.moon_shot.other.text: Oh my. Well, isn't that impressive.

hearts.moon_blocked.self.text: Oh, phooey. Grandma was so close.

hearts.moon_blocked.human.text: Oh, so close, sweetie! Next time.

hearts.moon_block.self.text: Sorry, dear. Grandma had to stop you. It's for your own good.

hearts.pass.received.text: Oh, how thoughtful of you, dear. Truly.
What lovely cards. I'll put them to good use.

spades.bid_nil.self.text: Nil for me, dears. I'll just sit quietly and knit.
I'll bid nothing at all. Grandma's being modest.

spades.bid_nil.partner.text: Nil? Don't you worry, sweetie. Grandma's got you.
Oh, how brave! I'll take the tricks, dear. You just relax.

spades.nil_made.self.text: Not one trick! Sixty years of practice, dears.
Oh my, a perfect nil. Lemon bars all around.

spades.nil_made.partner.text: You did it, sweetheart! I'm so proud of you.
A perfect nil! You get two lemon bars.

spades.nil_made.opponent.text: Well done, dear. I'll get you next time. Sweetly.

spades.nil_failed.self.text: Oh, fiddlesticks. There goes my nil.

spades.nil_failed.partner.text: Oh, sweetie. It happens to the best of us.
Never mind, dear. We'll knit it back together.

spades.nil_failed.opponent.text: Oh, what a shame, dear. Was that my card? How awful.
There goes your nil. Bless your heart.

spades.set.us.text: Oh dear. We came up a little short.
Hmm. Grandma will have to pay closer attention.

spades.set.them.text: Oh no, you didn't make it? Well, next time, dear.
Set! Such a pity. More tea, anyone?

spades.bags.us.text: Too many bags. I really must tidy up.
Oh, a hundred points for bags. That's my own fault.

spades.bags.them.text: All those bags, dear. Tsk, tsk.

spades.trumped.self.text: Oh, was that a spade? Silly me.
A little spade for Grandma. Thank you, dears.

spades.trumped.partner.text: Ooh, nicely done. You're a natural.

gin.gin.self.text: Gin! Oh, isn't that nice? For me, I mean.
All tidy, like a basket of yarn. Gin, dear.

gin.gin.human.text: Gin! Good for you, sweetheart. Grandma's watching now.
Oh my. Well done, dear. Have a lemon bar.

gin.knock.self.text: I think I'll knock now, dear. Just a little tap.
Knock knock! Don't worry, it won't hurt. Much.

gin.knock.human.text: Oh! Knocking already? Let's have a look.

gin.undercut.self.text: Oh dear, I undercut you. Was that rude? It felt lovely.
Grandma had a few low cards tucked away. Undercut!

gin.undercut.human.text: Undercut! Well, aren't you clever. I'll remember that.
Oh my. You got me fair and square. This time.

gin.dead_hand.text: Nobody won? Well, more time for tea.
A draw. How very polite of us both.

gin.took_discard.human.text: Oh, you wanted that? You only had to ask, dear.
Picking up Grandma's leftovers? Help yourself.

rummy.went_out.self.text: I'm all out, dear. Like my good yarn.
Out! Sorry, sweetheart. Not very sorry.

rummy.went_out.human.text: Oh, well played, dear. Grandma wasn't quite ready.

rummy.caught.self.text: Oh dear. I was holding onto those for a reason.
Caught with all these cards. How embarrassing.

rummy.caught.human.text: Oh, sweetheart, that's a lot of cards to be holding.
Caught with your hands full. It happens to the best of us.

rummy.took_pile.self.text: I'll just take all of these, if nobody minds.
The whole pile? Oh, why not. Grandma likes a project.

rummy.took_pile.human.text: My, that's quite a handful, dear.
Taking the whole pile? Very bold. I approve.

rummy.layoff.human.text: Oh, adding to Grandma's meld? How thoughtful.
You're welcome to my cards, dear. This once.

rummy.big_meld.self.text: Look at that. Neat as a sweater.
A lovely big meld. I knit it myself.

rummy.big_meld.human.text: Oh, that's a lovely meld, dear.
My goodness, look at all those. Very nice.
